title: Production orders
numberHint: The number is given when the order is saved.

progress.title: Progress of {{name}}
progress.reopenHint: This process is completed. Reopening it needs a note.

start.title: Start the production?
start.text: After the start the products and the processes cannot be changed. The stock of the materials is deducted by the BOM, the oldest lot first. The workers can then record progress.
start.hint: Save your changes first: the start uses the saved order.

errors.ORDER_NOT_READY: The order needs at least one product, and every product needs at least one process.
errors.ORDER_LOCKED: The production has started; the products and the processes cannot be changed.
errors.ORDER_NOT_STARTED: The production has not started yet.
errors.COMPLETED_LOCKED: This process is completed. Only an Admin can reopen it.
errors.TOO_HIGH: The quantity is larger than the quantity required.
errors.MUST_EQUAL_REQUIRED: A completed process must have the full quantity.
errors.MUST_BE_COMPLETED: With the full quantity the status must be Completed.
errors.MUST_BE_ZERO: A process that is not started has no completed quantity.
errors.REOPEN_NOTE: Write a note to reopen a completed process.
errors.INVALID_DATE: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.ORDER_INVOICED: The order is invoiced; its progress cannot change.
errors.STOCK_SHORT: There is not enough stock, so the production did not start. Add stock first.
